create_training_arguments: create a TrainingArguments instance to configure model training with output directory and batch size
configure_training_hyperparameters: configure training hyperparameters including learning rate, batch size, epochs, and gradient checkpointing
configure_optimizer_settings: configure optimizer settings including name, learning rate, weight decay, and beta parameters
configure_learning_rate_scheduler: configure learning rate scheduler type, warmup steps, and training duration
configure_hub_push_integration: configure Hugging Face Hub push integration with model ID, strategy, and repository privacy
